content.short: Accountable issues cryptographic proofs of solvency, holdings and yield for tokenized assets.
content.description: Accountable runs a verification network that proves assets and liabilities without disclosing the underlying positions, producing real-time cryptographic evidence of solvency, vault holdings and yield for tokenized products. It operates on Monad. Proof of reserves became a serious concern after several custodial failures, and the hard part has always been proving solvency rather than merely asserting reserves, since liabilities are the side that is easy to hide.
content.meta: Real-time solvency and holdings verification for tokenized assets, proved cryptographically rather than asserted.
